policy.owner_instruction: nothing should be paid ... cut the probes and make them free.
policy.why_one_door: If any script may name its own model, one of them will name a paid one. scripts/llm/router.js is the only door: it refuses an id that does not end in :free before a request is made, so a paid model cannot be reached even by a typo.
policy.on_no_free_model: named stop NO_FREE_MODEL_ANSWERED; never a paid model, never a silent skip

selection: The strongest $0/$0 instruct models with at least 32k of context in the snapshot below, strongest first, with a small fast one last so a rate-limited queue still answers. thinkingmachines/inkling:free and inkling-small:free are excluded: they return 403 for this account (seen again on 3 Nov 2026 in the sibling repos). OpenRouter's openrouter/free meta-router is excluded because its id does not end in ':free', which the checklist requires of every id so the rule can be read mechanically instead of argued about.

engine_consumers.purpose: writes and checks the daily patient-question pages under /questions/
engine_consumers.note: The engine runs its own $0 lanes (OpenRouter :free, the free Gemini tier and Workers AI) and has no paid fallback. This repository passes it only the free-lane secrets; no paid key exists in its secret list.

repo_consumers_why: No script in this repository calls a model today: the writing is the shared engine's job and every collector here reads Search Console, which is not a model. The router exists so the first script that needs one cannot invent its own door.
